ms.report:
We are delighted to report the successful completion of first internal tests of Milkomeda Liquid Staking devnet deploymnets. 

Smart Contract and Testing: The Liquid Staking Solidity contract has been developed on milkomeda c1-devnet, thoroughly tested, and passed all test cases. Tests covered critical functionalities such as ADA deposits, accruing rewards, and rewards withdrawal. The corresponding bindings are now published in the NPM package, ensuring easy integration for future developments.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dcspark/milkomeda-liquid-staking
Our team is preparing now to cover all QA Test suite with bridge side implementation of liquid staking (cardano pools -> milkomeda bridge - > Milkomeda EVM)
Documentation: Comprehensive documentation has been created detailing both the holistic system operation and Solidity-specific aspects. This will serve as a useful resource for anyone looking to understand the mechanisms of our liquid staking contract or build upon it.
https://github.com/dcSpark/milkomeda-documentation/tree/liquid-staking/docs/cardano/liquid-staking

Preparation for Mainnet Release: Post successful devnet testing, our team is now in the final stages of preparing for the mainnet release.

We sincerely apologize for the delayed reporting of this Proof Of Milestone. Our team has been dedicatedly working towards meeting all the requirements and conducting thorough tests for both the bridge and contract side, ensuring their successful deployment on NPM. Now we are planning to submit next PoMs accordingly.
